Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. But don't go anywhere as India will take on Netherlands soon. So, switch the tabs and join us for all the coverage there. Till then, cheers!
Rilee Rossouw is the Player of the Match.
...Presentation coming up...

It was top-class bowling from the Proteas. It was filled with fiery bowling from Anrich Nortje and Kagiso Rabada while Tabraiz Shamsi showed his magic yet again and claimed 3 wickets. However, it was Anrich Nortje's first over that shifted the momentum. He took two in his first and overall with four wickets, his best T20I figures. A one-sided affair in the end. However, it was set up by Rilee Rossouw and Quinton de Kock with the bat. The former scored a wonderful ton and helped his team get over 200 and it turned out to be more than enough.

Bangladesh were behind the 8-ball from the start of the chase. They had a good start but once Anrich Nortje was introduced, they lost both the openers in quick succession. Shakib Al Hasan got out to an LBW decision that could have been refereed upstairs and could have survived. He fell and after that, there wasn't much from the other batters. Litton Das stayed for a long time but the chase was just too big for Bangladesh.
A comprehensive win for the Proteas. They dominated in all three departments and with such a huge margin win, they boost their net rate rate. For now, they go on top of group 2.
OUT! BOWLED! Anrich Nortje gets his fourth wicket! On a length and on leg. Ahmed again swings across but misses and the ball hits the bails of the leg pole. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 104 RUNS.
Nortje again follows Ahmed on the leg side with a length ball. Ahmed swings and misses.
Short in length and on middle. Ahmed steps back as he looks to pull but misses.
Shorter and outside off, cut to deep cover for one.

Rahman swings hard but this is way outside off. He gets a top edge and the ball goes high and to mid off. Temba Bavuma runs back from mid off but he could have left for the man running from long off. The ball falls safely. A single.
SIX! Rahman shows his capability with the bat! Floated on middle. Rahman slogs it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Wide! Sliding way down the leg side. Rahman misses his sweep.
Very full and on off, driven to long off for a single.
This one spins sharply away, full and outside off. Ahmed looks to defend but misses.
Tossed up, outside off, turning away. Ahmed defends off his splice to point.
A yorker, outside off. Rahman jams it out to third man for a couple.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! On a length and on middle. Taskin knocks it straight to cover and rushes for a quick single. Hasan was touch late to react. Rabada hits at the batter's end and the replay shows Hasan was well out. Excellent fielding.
FOUR! Well played! Taskin anticipates a short ball and stays back. He smacks it over mid on for a boundary.
Nortje drops it short and around off. Taskin looks to pull but misses. That one whizzes past the batter.
On top of middle. Taskin defends it to mid-wicket.
On a length and around off. Taskin blocks it out.
Anrich Nortje is back on.
Tossed up on off. Hasan keeps it out.
Shorter and outside off. Hasan looks to cut but misses.
Hasan Mahmud walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the end of Das' innings! Floated full ball on middle. Das slogs-sweeps but only to find deep mid-wicket. Tristan Stubbs dropped Das earlier but not this time. A good catch from him.
Commentary.Howout: c Tristan Stubbs b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Again hit there! Flighted ball outside off. Taskin drives it to the right of Shamsi who this time gets finger-tips on it. A single.
Tossed up on off. Das skips down and chips it to the right of Shamsi for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Taskin taps it to point. He stumbles to get to the other end but eventually makes his ground. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end as well.
Tossed up, outside off. Taskin drives on the up to deep cover for one.
An arm ball on middle. Das works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Taskin drives it to long off for one.
This one skids through, shorter and outside off. Ahmed looks to punch but misses.
Sliding on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off. Das cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
Taskin Ahmed walks in now.
OUT! Shamsi gets his second! Flighted, full ball, around off. Hasan slogs and tries to clear the shorter side but fails to power much. Anrich Nortje at deep square leg takes with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Anrich Nortje b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, around off. Hasan prods and blocks it out.
Flatter and around off. Das clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Hasan slog-sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter, quicker, skids on. Hasan defends.
Tossed up, outside off. Hasan pushes it to cover.
Floated on middle. Das flicks it to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Pushes hard for the second. Quinton de Kock clips the bails in flash but Das was in.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.

OUT! STUMPED! Maharaj slows it down, this is full and outside off. Mosaddek Hossain comes down the track as he swings across but only to miss and Quinton de Kock removes the bails with ease. Mosaddek Hossain is out by miles. He doesn't even bother to get back.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! Flatter and around off. Das sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary. Much needed and a welcome boundary for Bangladesh.
Flatter and outside off. Das dabs but straight to backward point.
Flatter and outside off, going across. Hossain looks to drive but misses.
On middle, kept out.

OUT! TAKEN! Tabraiz Shamsi gets one now! This is full, slower and around leg. Hasan comes down the track to heave across but mistimes and only gets height on it. Aiden Markram at deep mid-wicket settles under it and takes it easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Very full and on off. Hasan clips it to deep mid-wicket for a brace now.
Wide! A slower ball way down the leg side. Hasan misses his flick.
Fuller ball on off. Das flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Hasan drives it through covers for one.
Quinton de Kock is feeling some pain in his right thumb. Time for magic spray...
On the stumps again. Das punches it back to Maharaj. Another tidy over from South Africa.
Quicker and on middle. Hasan helps it to short fine leg for one.
This time Das connects and hits it behind square leg for one.
Swing and a miss! Tossed up, sliding around leg. Das looks to slog-sweep but misses.
Flatter and outside off. Hasan uses his feet and knocks it to cover for a single.
This is full and on middle. Hasan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Just four off the over! Not enough for Bangladesh to stay in the game. On a length and on middle. Hasan drills it to mid-wicket for one.
On a length and around off. Hasan drops it to point.
Touch short and outside off. Hasan steps across and bends back to let it go.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
On middle, Hasan works it to deep square leg for one.

DROPPED! That should have been taken! Short ball on middle. Das gets a top edge as he looks to pull. It goes to deep bakcward square leg where the fielder drops a sitter. Sun might have not helped Stubbs there.
Very full and on leg. Das flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A slower ball on middle. Hasan works it to square leg for one more.
On the pads, nudges to square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Hasan inside edges his flick to square leg for a single.
Flatter ball on middle. Das bunts it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and sliding around leg. Das goes back only to miss his flick. An appeal but that was going down.
Keshav Maharaj is into the attack.
On a length and on middle. Hasan blocks it out. Bangladesh are 47/4 at the end of the Powerplay. 159 runs needed in 84 balls.

OUT! TAKEN! Afif Hossain mistimes yet again and this time it goes in the hands of the fielder! This is superb stuff from South Africa. Pacey stuff from them! This is near the 140 regions. Short of a length and outside off. Hossain looks to pull but miscues, it goes more off the top edge and to mid off where Wayne Parnell runs forward and slides to take it. Bangladesh in all sorts of trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Wayne Parnell b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off. Hossain looks to pull but mistimes it back to Rabada who gets low to his left and collects on the bounce.
Wide! Too short and on off. Hossain fails to ramp it over. Wided.
On Shakib Al Hasan's wicket, the replay shows it was PITCHING OUTSIDE LEG. Shakib Al Hasan should have reviewed it.
On middle, bunted to square leg for one.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
A length ball on middle. Das nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and on leg. Hossain misses his flick. It was pitching outside the line this time.
FOUR BYES! Anrich Nortje steams in and serves it at 153 clicks. Short and on  middle. Hossain looks to ramp but misses. It goes over the keeper for a boundary.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! SHAKIB GOES! Body-blow for Bangladesh as they lose their skipper! Shakib Al Hasan knew he was out as soon as he got rapped on the pads. That was an easy decision for the umpire. Anrich Nortje serves a very full ball on middle. Shakib Al Hasan shuffles way to across in his crease to flick but misses and gets pinged on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Anrich Nortje gets his third now.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Das swings and misses.
Full and outside off, Das drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
On a length and on off. Das drops it to mid off for a quick single.
SIX! Welcome boundary! Slightly short and Das does not miss. He rocks back and pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
This is on a length and on off. Das pushes it to mid off but for no run.
Full and way outside off. Kept out.
On middle. Shakib fends it to square leg for one more.
Full and outside off. Das splices his drive to third man for one.
A bouncer to end the over. This is just down leg but the umpire feels it is legal. Shakib evades it.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.

OUT! TIMBER! Both the openers are gone! This is quick, pacy stuff from Nortje! On a length and on middle at 147 clicks. Shanto has a wild swing across the line but misses and the ball hits the stumps. Anrich Nortje has a big smile on his face. South Africa are  enjoying while two wickets now and Bangladesh shift on the back foot.
Short of a length and on leg. Shanto mistimes his pull and it rolls back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off. Das punches it through point for one.
Litton Das comes out.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Change of bowling and Anrich Nortje takes the wicket straightaway! Much needed as Bangladesh were off to a flier! On a length and outside off, angling across at 147 kph. Sarkar looks to drive it hard but gets a faint outside edge to Quinton de Kock who pouches it. Soumya Sarkar thinks to review but ends up taking the long walk back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: Change. Anrich Nortje to bowl now.
HIT HARD FOR TWO! Short and on middle. Shanto pulls it wide of deep square leg for one.
On middle, Sarkar tucks it to square leg for one more.
Wide! Just sliding down the leg side. Sarkar misses his flick.
This is on a length and on off. Sarkar blocks it out.
Length ball on middle. Sarkar works it to deep square leg for two more.
Back of a length and on middle, Shanto pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Short of a length and on middle. Shanto pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Wayne Parnell.

SIX! Sarkar is not messing around! Already showing his intent! This is not good from Rabada! He is bowling in the slot as he looks for some swing. This is on the pads, it is flicked on the up and all the way over square leg for a six.
SIX! Just flick of the wrist! Fantastic start by Bangladesh! Sarkar is off the mark with a six. This is full and on the pads. Sarkar whips it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Rabada tries a yorker but ends up with a full toss on the pads. Shanto tickles it to short fine leg for one.
Length ball, outside off. Shanto punches it to cover.
FOUR! FIne shot! On a length and around off. Shanto hammers it over mid on, not off the middle but gets enough elevation to clear the fielder. First boundary and Bangladesh are off the mark.
On a length and outside off. Shanto taps it straight to the fielder at point.
